items.summary_1line: Knowledge engineering (KE) turns raw files into a reasoning-ready knowledge base, a task now within reach of LLM agents. KE has progressed from chunk and graph retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to memory agents, ag...

items.summary_1line: Multimodal knowledge graph reasoning (MKGR) aims to infer missing facts by jointly exploiting relational structures, textual descriptions, and visual evidence. Existing embedding-based methods effectively capture grap...

items.summary_1line: User simulators offer a scalable way to evaluate interactive agents, but how to assess their quality remains underexplored. In particular, it is unclear whether existing user simulator evaluation frameworks reliably d...
items.editor_note: 사용자 시뮬레이터 평가 프레임워크가 좋은 시뮬레이터와 나쁜 시뮬레이터를 안정적으로 구분하는지 묻는다.

items.summary_1line: Jailbreak attempts and harmful prompts remain a challenge for the safe deployment of large language models. We study whether contrastively learned representations can support safety detection without training an addit...

However, they may produce hallucinations, false or misleading content not grounded in the source text, which can mislead analysts and corrupt
items.editor_note: 사이버 위협 인텔리전스 요약과 QA에서 환각을 탐색적으로 측정한다.

Label-free directions from honest and deceptive role-play are untested at 70B scale and on lies about knowledge, where a lie and an honest denial can be identical. We widen a publishe
items.editor_note: 선형 프로브가 전이에 실패하는 경우가 많은 70B 규모에서, 레이블 없는 지식 방향과 페르소나 방향을 거짓말 프로브로 시험한다.

items.title: When Are Images Needed in Multimodal Machine Translation? Text-Only Routing for On-Demand Visual Context
items.summary_1line: Proposes PreVIR, a lightweight text-only router that decides from the source sentence alone whether to invoke visual features in English-to-Chinese machine translation, reducing visual calls while keeping quality near always-on multimodal inference.
items.editor_note: 문장별로 시각 특징이 필요한지 판단하는 텍스트 전용 라우터로, 번역에서 시각 호출을 줄인다.

items.summary_1line: Foundation-model agents are increasingly extending beyond software engineering (SWE) into autonomous scientific research, where acquiring and integrating domain knowledge remains a critical challenge. Recent industria...

items.title: Search-RSI: Expanding Search Worlds Along Multimodal Agents' Capability Frontier
items.summary_1line: Search-RSI is a self-improvement framework for multimodal search agents that expands the retrieval world with new tasks and evidence, reporting 9.8 and 9.5 point average accuracy gains at 9B and 27B across nine benchmarks.
items.editor_note: Search-RSI는 에이전트가 개선됨에 따라 검색 범위를 넓히며, 9개 벤치마크에서 9B와 27B 평균 9.8점, 9.5점 향상을 보고했다.

items.title: Evaluating Prompting Strategies for Zero-Shot Multilingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis with Large Language Models
items.summary_1line: Evaluates zero-shot multilingual aspect-based sentiment triplet extraction across 12 languages, three domains and seven open-weight LLMs under four prompting strategies, finding direct monolithic prompting performs best.
items.editor_note: 12개 언어와 7개 오픈 웨이트 모델에서 감성 트리플릿에는 직접적인 모놀리식 프롬프팅이 다른 전략보다 우수했다.

items.title: The Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework: Scalable Multimodal UX Attribution in Web Search
items.summary_1line: Describes a two-tier industrial framework for automated UX attribution in web search: a fine-tuned Gemini XS telemetry model for macro sentiment regression detection, and a Gemini 3.0 Pro multimodal model for layout-level diagnostics.
items.editor_note: 웹 검색의 감성 회귀 탐지와 레이아웃 진단을 위한 산업용 2단계 Gemini 구성.

items.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
items.summary_1line: MemOnce proposes an LLM architecture that caches compact final-layer hidden states as memory and decodes them into KV caches, reporting a 1313× smaller memory state cache and 6.9× lower prefill latency for Qwen3.5-4B at 1M context.
items.editor_note: MemOnce는 마지막 레이어 상태를 캐시하고 이를 KV로 디코딩하며, Qwen3.5-4B의 1M 컨텍스트에서 메모리 캐시가 1313배 작고 프리필이 6.9배 낮다고 보고했다.

items.title: Population-Based Post-Training for Large Language Models
items.summary_1line: Introduces Population-Based Post-Training (PBPT), which trains several RLVR models in parallel and uses population-based training to tune hyperparameters, reporting stronger agents than compute-matched independent runs on four benchmarks.
items.editor_note: 집단 기반 하이퍼파라미터 튜닝으로 여러 RLVR 학습을 병렬로 수행하며, 연산량을 맞춘 독립 학습보다 강한 에이전트를 얻었다고 보고했다.

items.title: KernelShift: Benchmarking Kernel Optimization Across Evolving Hardware
items.summary_1line: KernelShift is a benchmark that tests coding agents on CPU kernel optimization across Arm Neon, SVE, SVE2 and SME2, finding agents beat the compiler and some libraries but lag KleidiAI and struggle with SME2.
items.editor_note: 코딩 에이전트는 Arm CPU 커널에서 컴파일러를 앞서지만 KleidiAI에는 못 미치고 SME2에서는 어려움을 겪는다.

items.title: mini-psych-agent: Evaluating Human-Like Behavior in LLM Agents through Interactive Psychological Environments
items.summary_1line: Presents mini-psych-agent, which converts psychological tasks into interactive environments and uses a learned human-policy model to measure how closely LLM agents' behavior matches human choices, finding this varies with agent configuration and task.
items.why_it_matters: Matches feed focus: agentic, harness, evaluation.
items.editor_note: 인터랙티브 심리 과제에서 에이전트 행동이 인간의 선택과 얼마나 일치하는지 측정하며, 에이전트 구성에 따라 달라진다.

items.title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Contrastive Decoding for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Large Language Models
items.summary_1line: Introduces CONCOR, a controlled benchmark that scores how contrastive decoding methods rank ground-truth objects against hallucinated candidates in multimodal LLMs, using a Contrastive Grounding Margin metric.
items.editor_note: CONCOR 벤치마크는 대조 디코딩이 실제 객체와 환각된 객체의 순위를 얼마나 잘 매기는지로 다시 점수를 매긴다.

items.title: Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
items.summary_1line: LatentParse is a training-free framework that uses an analyst VLM to parse CLIP, DINOv3 and VGGT features into a text report of spatial evidence, improving five VLMs by 0.7-2.4 points on three spatial benchmarks.
items.editor_note: 비전 인코더 특징을 텍스트 근거로 변환하는 학습 불필요 파싱 방식으로, 공간 벤치마크에서 0.7~2.4점 향상을 보였다.

items.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
items.summary_1line: Introduces ToolSmith, a framework that automatically generates and reuses new tools on top of a lean base library for multimodal search agents, evaluated on 13 benchmarks with gains that grow with backbone size.
items.editor_note: 최신 항목: ToolSmith는 멀티모달 검색 에이전트를 위해 도구를 생성하고 재사용하며, 13개 벤치마크에서 백본이 클수록 이득이 커졌다.

editorial.tldr: This thread is a reading list of LLM research papers grouped by shared wording, not one event. From Nov 4 it ran through agent benchmarks, kernel and serving work, eval validity and multimodal hallucination, then Nov 13-19 papers on abstention, jailbreak screening and lie probes.
editorial.whats_new: Nov 23: ToolSmith has multimodal search agents generate and reuse their own tools across 13 benchmarks, three days after Search-RSI reported 9.8- and 9.5-point gains at 9B and 27B by growing the agent's search world.
editorial.why_it_matters: Most items are single unreplicated preprints, but the late-November run moves toward agents that extend their own tools, search space and memory, which touches tool registries and KV-cache budgets in a serving stack.
editorial.take_for_builders: Before letting an agent add tools or memory at runtime, gate it: review generated tools before they enter the shared registry, log which ones get reused, and measure any cached-memory scheme's answer quality on your own long-context traffic, not only its prefill latency.

beats.summary: Search-RSI (Nov 20) expands the retrieval world as the agent improves; ToolSmith (Nov 23) generates and reuses new tools on a lean base library.

open_questions: Do ToolSmith's generated tools stay correct when reused on new tasks, and how is a faulty generated tool detected and retired?
Does MemOnce's 6.9x lower prefill at 1M context hold answer quality on long-context tasks beyond Qwen3.5-4B?
Do the knowledge and persona lie-probe directions detect lies on models outside the study, and at what false-positive rate?
Does the contrastive-prototype jailbreak detector report false-positive rates on benign prompts and hold up against adaptive attacks?
Does stability-compensated threshold calibration keep its error guarantee when the deployed model or prompt distribution shifts?
Under the CONCOR benchmark, which published contrastive decoding methods still reduce multimodal hallucination?
